note: Primary cohort descriptions of Ramond-Elliott syndrome explicitly confirm that infantile spasms and feeding difficulties are core, frequent manifestations.

evidence.text: A study of 12 individuals with clustered TRA2B loss-of-function variants found that all individuals presented with intellectual disability/developmental delay, frequently associated with infantile spasms, feeding difficulties, microcephaly, and brain anomalies.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5′ coding region of TRA2B cause a distinctive neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: All affected individuals presented intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, frequently associated with infantile spasms, microcephaly, brain anomalies, autism spectrum disorder, feeding difficulties, and short stature.
